claim.claim-text: 1. An electrode for a solid state battery which comprises a plurality of electrode active material particles, a first polymer electrolyte, a second polymer electrolyte and a conductive material,

wherein the electrode active material particles are at least partially surface-coated with a first coating layer comprising a mixture of the first polymer electrolyte and the conductive material, the second polymer electrolyte at least partially covers the surface of the first coating layer, the surface of the particles or both surfaces, and the electrode active material particles are bound to each other by at least one of the first polymer electrolyte and the second polymer electrolyte to form an integrated structure, the first coating layer has a structural feature formed by an electrospraying process, in which the first coating layer is formed by subjecting a slurry comprising the electrode active material particles, the first polymer electrolyte and the conductive material to the electrospraying process.

2. The electrode according to claim 1, wherein each of the first and the second polymer electrolyte independently include at least one of a polyether polymer, polycarbonate polymer, acrylate polymer, polysiloxane polymer, phosphazene polymer, polyethylene derivative, alkylene oxide derivative, polymer of an ester of phosphoric acid, polyagitation lysine, polyester sulfide, polyvinyl alcohol, polyvinylidene fluoride, polymer containing an ionically dissociatable group.
3. The electrode according to claim 1, the first and the second polymer electrolyte is different from each other,
4. The electrode according to claim 1, wherein each of the first coating layer comprises polycarbonate polymer or polysiloxane polymer or both of them.
5. The electrode according to claim 1, wherein the electrode does not include a binder.
6. The electrode according to claim 1, wherein the amount of the first polymer electrolyte is 2-10 parts by weight based on 100 parts by weight of the electrode active material.
